full_page.content:
1954, March 18
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. (from the Photocopy)
March 18, 1954
Miss Doris Panyard 1705 Peck Street Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
Blessed be God! In all His designs.
God bless you Miss Doras Panyard -- you and yours. May the dear Lord bless you all: May He Himself be your reward and your final Crown, as He is to be for all who by His holy grace shall persevere.
Sincerely yours in Christ
God's blessing to all
April 13 In all his designs blest be God!
Fr. Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
The original in possession of : Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
